_설명: 단계별 배경음악 프롬프트. Suno(또는 다른 음악 생성 서비스)에 그대로 넣는다. instrumental로 만들고, 받은 파일은 tools/music_import.py로 루프를 잘라 data/music/<id>.ogg로 둔다. bpm과 key는 지금 내장 8비트 합성음과 맞춘 값이다.
common_style: 8-bit chiptune, NES-style pulse and triangle waves, noise-channel drums, instrumental, no vocals, seamless loop, office-tower climbing game

bgm_stage1.prompt: upbeat cheerful 8-bit chiptune, bright square-wave lead, bouncy bass, first day at the office, hopeful

bgm_stage2.prompt: driving 8-bit chiptune in D minor, busy arpeggios, ticking hi-hat noise, deadlines piling up, slightly anxious

bgm_stage3.prompt: moody mid-tempo 8-bit chiptune in E minor, rainy evening overtime, melancholic triangle bass, steady march

bgm_stage4.prompt: tense fast 8-bit chiptune in C minor, aggressive pulse lead, pounding noise drums, corporate power struggle, boss-fight energy

bgm_stage5.prompt: epic climactic 8-bit chiptune in G minor, heroic square-wave fanfare over rapid arpeggios, final ascent to the CEO office
